candidate_program.name: weighted_overlap_margin
candidate_program.rationale: Discounts raw conflict reward using pairwise minimum-weight overlap, retaining the strongest rival as a floor on estimated loss. The normalized margin uses active neighbors only; local edge enumeration can be quadratic in degree.
candidate_program.rule: (weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight - 2 * neighbor_overlap_mass / max(1, degree))) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
